label: Team members
description: People who help manage some of your listings. Add their email and tick the listings they handle. They get an email invite, confirm their email address, and can then edit those listings and see only the enquiries about them. You keep full control of everything.

access.create: admin or owning developer / team member

access.delete: admin or owning developer / team member

fields.description: They sign in with this exact address. They must confirm it before anything is shared.

fields.name: listings
fields.label: Listings they handle
fields.description: They can edit and delete only these, and see only the enquiries about them. Their email is also copied on every enquiry for these listings.
